# Structural transfer-v2 fixtures — fake media only

These bundles reproduce the Citrus producer at commit
`e881f5258be83231b62a00a6f9c4e5fcd69cd548`. Their MP4/H5 files are conspicuously
labeled text placeholders and their finalization records are test stubs. **Never
submit these to production staging or treat them as scientific/codec evidence.**

- `whole/`: one camera, single video, H5 context; native clip-field omissions and
  successful null container error fields are deliberate compatibility cases.
- `rolling/`: two cameras, two clips, full + moving-crop outputs, shorter final
  clip, video-only. Each camera is one parent, not one parent per video/clip.
- `failed_optional_proof/`: one camera, single video, present summary with
  `frame_identity_proof.status="failed"`. Transport verification **accepts** the
  limited metadata-order/packet-parity claim; Palette admission must **refuse**.
  Optional proof absence never licenses ignoring a present failed proof.
- [review_cases.json](review_cases.json): shared accepted/refused path examples,
  independent and combined clip/container contradictions, and consumer-refusal
  expectation. Byte-identical to the pinned Citrus test corpus.

All three bundles include source manifests, local metadata, closed snapshot and
v2 marker. Delivery UUID/time are deterministic fixture values. Other matrix and
negative cases are generated by `tests/test_recording_transfer_v2.py` in Citrus.

From the pinned Citrus checkout:

```bash
python3 tests/recording_transfer_fixture.py --output /tmp/new-transfer-fixtures
python3 scripts/recording_transfer_v2.py --verify-only --destination /tmp/new-transfer-fixtures/whole
python3 scripts/recording_transfer_v2.py --verify-only --destination /tmp/new-transfer-fixtures/rolling
python3 scripts/recording_transfer_v2.py --verify-only --destination /tmp/new-transfer-fixtures/failed_optional_proof
```

The output root must not exist. For validation of these committed fixtures, pass
their absolute bundle paths instead. Modifying any payload file or
adding files inside a bundle root invalidates its snapshot. This README lives
outside those roots deliberately.

To replay a shared contradiction case, create a fresh unsealed source with the
pinned `fixture()` helper. Apply `clip_contradictions[*].set` to its sole clip
(use `clips=1` for rolling), or `finalization_contradictions[*].set` to the named
section of one output's finalization sidecar. Each must refuse transfer before
publishing a success marker. Citrus tests also rehash altered bundle payloads and
assert independent loadback refusal, so checks are not merely stale-hash detection.

Path examples apply to snapshot artifact paths and clip directory fields.
Original absolute source-manifest references have a separate, restricted rebasing
step. The shared corpus is outside all payload roots; it is not part of their
inventories. Full Draft 2020-12 engine and Palette admission tests remain consumer
work, not claims established by these fake-media bundles.
